scenes.name: ONE ZERO MORE
lines: Can a matrix with an old zero direction gain exactly one new zero direction?
已有零方向的矩阵，还能恰好多一个零方向吗？
Start with diagonal entries minus two, zero, and three. Choose the first coordinate direction.
从对角元负二、零、三开始，选择第一坐标方向。
The quadratic pivot is minus two. The structured change turns that first entry into zero, while the old zero survives.
二次主元为负二；结构改动把第一项变成零，原来的零也保留。

scenes.name: ISOLATE THE PIVOT
lines: The general mechanism is to isolate a scalar block. The original matrix may be singular.
一般机制是隔离一个标量块，原矩阵可以奇异。
Split every vector into a part perpendicular to A x, and a part along x. A nonzero pivot makes this split unique.
把向量拆成垂直于 A x 的部分与沿 x 的部分；主元非零使拆分唯一。
In these coordinates the matrix has blocks C and delta. The changed matrix has blocks C and zero.
在这些坐标中，原矩阵的块为 C 与 delta，改动后的块为 C 与零。
A positive pivot removes one positive direction; a negative pivot removes one negative direction.
正主元移去一个正方向，负主元移去一个负方向。

scenes.name: OLD KERNEL PLUS ONE LINE
lines: The exact kernel is the old kernel plus the line through x, with zero intersection.
精确的新核是旧核与 x 直线的直和，交集为零。
If the changed matrix kills v, subtract a suitable multiple of x. What remains lies in the old kernel.
若改动后的矩阵消去 v，减去适当倍数的 x，余下部分就在旧核中。
Thus nullity rises by one and rank falls by one. No inverse of the original matrix is required.
所以零度增加一，秩减少一；无须原矩阵的逆。

scenes.name: CONNECTEDNESS FIXES THE INDEX
lines: Now vary a diagonal matrix continuously, keeping the pivot nonzero and the changed matrix positive semidefinite.
让对角矩阵连续变化，始终保持主元非零，改动后的矩阵半正定。
On a connected domain the pivot keeps one sign. In the negative branch, exactly one diagonal entry is negative at every point.
在连通域上主元符号固定；负分支中每点恰有一个负对角元。
The regions where each coordinate is negative are disjoint, open, and closed. Connectedness forces one region to be the whole domain.
各坐标为负的区域彼此不交，既开又闭；连通性迫使其中一个就是全域。
Punctured simplices of dimension at least two stay connected after countably many punctures. A punctured interval can disconnect.
维数至少二的开单纯形删去可数点后仍连通；区间删去一点却可能断开。

scenes.name: TWO COORDINATES ARE NOT ENOUGH
lines: A linked sphere question asks whether the smallest alignment ratio always needs at most two active coordinates.
关联球面问题问：最小对齐比值是否总只需两个活跃坐标？
Use the increasing odd polynomial h of t equals three t minus t cubed, divided by two.
取递增奇多项式 h：三倍 t 减 t 的立方，再除以二。
Write p for squared coordinates. Two coordinates have exact squared minimum eighty over eighty-one.
用 p 表示平方坐标；两个坐标的比值平方最小值精确为八十除以八十一。
But squared coordinates four fifths, one tenth, one tenth give a strictly smaller value. Three coordinates beat every two-coordinate vector.
但平方坐标五分之四、十分之一、十分之一给出更小值；三个坐标胜过所有二坐标向量。

scenes.name: ONE LARGE COORDINATE, MANY SMALL ONES
lines: The moments give a uniform lower bound. Put a equal to the square root of the second moment; the third moment is at most a cubed.
矩给出统一下界；令 a 为二阶矩的平方根，三阶矩不超过 a 的立方。
A one-variable minimum occurs at a star equals six minus three times the square root of three.
一元最小值在 a 星等于六减三倍根号三处取得。
Keep one squared coordinate at a star, and spread the remaining mass equally over more and more coordinates.
固定一个平方坐标为 a 星，将余下质量均分给越来越多的坐标。
The tail moments vanish, and the ratio approaches the sharp infimum. No finite vector attains it.
尾部的矩趋于零，比值逼近尖锐下确界，但没有有限向量达到它。

scenes.name: SOURCES AND SCOPE
lines: Lucid posed the questions, and user fifteen fifty-one gave the earlier inertia proof.
问题由 Lucid 提出，更早的惯性证明归于 user1551。
Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang give the self-contained proof, family extensions, and exact polynomial bound.
Haobo Ma 与 Wenlin Zhang 给出自洽证明、连续族推广与精确多项式界。
The book links exact Lean declarations for the matrix statements, and complete written proofs for the broader results.
书中链接矩阵结论的精确 Lean 声明，并完整给出更广结论的书面证明。
